Descope.//: Validates the session token the app sends. ProjectId is also the token issuer.

PasswordPolicy.//: Mirrored by the checklist the app shows while typing — change both together.

Registration.//: How long a pending registration stays usable before the member must start again.

PasswordHashing.//: Best-practice PBKDF2. Raise Iterations as hardware improves. Scheme is the swap seam.

Database.//: Provider = InMemory (mock, dev default) or SqlServer (registration's OWN database).

ConnectionStrings.//: Registration's OWN database (separate from the member DB). Required when Database:Provider = SqlServer.
